verses.text: Woe [to] her who is rebellious and defiled, the oppressing city!

segments.text: Woe [to] her who is rebellious and defiled, the oppressing city!

verses.text: She has not listened to [His] voice, she does not receive discipline; in YHWH she does not trust; to her God she does not draw near.

segments.text: She has not listened to [His] voice, she does not receive discipline; in YHWH she does not trust; to her God she does not draw near.

verses.text: Her princes within her [are] roaring lions, her judges [are] wolves of the evening leaving nothing for the morning.

segments.text: Her princes within her [are] roaring lions, her judges [are] wolves of the evening leaving nothing for the morning.

verses.text: Her prophets are reckless, men of treacheries; her priests have profaned the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.

segments.text: Her prophets are reckless, men of treacheries; her priests have profaned the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.

verses.text: YHWH [is] righteous within her; He will not do injustice; morning by morning He gives His justice; at the light He is not lacking; the unjust one is knowing no shame.

segments.text: YHWH [is] righteous within her; He will not do injustice; morning by morning He gives His justice; at the light He is not lacking; the unjust one is knowing no shame.

verses.text: “I have cut off nations; their corners are desolate; I have made desolate their streets without one passing through; their cities are destroyed, without a man, with no one dwelling.

segments.text: “I have cut off nations; their corners are desolate; I have made desolate their streets without one passing through; their cities are destroyed, without a man, with no one dwelling.

verses.text: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me; you will receive discipline.’ Then her dwelling would not be cut off, by all that I have visited upon her. Nevertheless, they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.

segments.text: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me; you will receive discipline.’ Then her dwelling would not be cut off, by all that I have visited upon her. Nevertheless, they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.

verses.text: Therefore wait for Me,” a declaration of YHWH, “Until the day of My arising to testify. For My judgment [is] to gather the nations, to assemble unto Me the kingdoms, to pour out on them My indignation, all the burning of my nose! Indeed, with the fire of My jealousy all the earth will be consumed.

verses.text: For then I will turn over to the peoples a lip made pure, to call for all of them on the name of YHWH, to serve Him with one shoulder.

segments.text: For then I will turn over to the peoples a lip made pure, to call for all of them on the name of YHWH, to serve Him with one shoulder.

verses.text: From beyond the rivers of Cush, My worshipers, the daughter of My dispersed ones, will bring My offering.

segments.text: From beyond the rivers of Cush, My worshipers, the daughter of My dispersed ones, will bring My offering.

verses.text: On that day you will not feel shame from any of your deeds, with which you have transgressed against Me; for then I will turn away from your midst the jubilant ones of your pride, and you will continue no longer to be haughty on the mountain of My holiness.

segments.text: On that day you will not feel shame from any of your deeds, with which you have transgressed against Me; for then I will turn away from your midst the jubilant ones of your pride, and you will continue no longer to be haughty on the mountain of My holiness.

verses.text: And I will leave in your midst a people humble and poor, and they will take refuge in the name of YHWH.

segments.text: And I will leave in your midst a people humble and poor, and they will take refuge in the name of YHWH.

verses.text: The remnant of Israel will not do injustice, and they will not speak lies, and in their mouth will not be found a tongue of deceit. For they will feed the flocks and will lie down, and there will not be one frightening them.”

verses.text: Sing out, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem!

segments.text: Sing out, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem!

verses.text: YHWH has turned aside your judgments; He has turned back your enemy; the King of Israel, YHWH, [is] among you; you will fear evil no more.

segments.text: YHWH has turned aside your judgments; He has turned back your enemy; the King of Israel, YHWH, [is] among you; you will fear evil no more.

verses.text: On that day it will be said to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion, do not let your hands be slack!

verses.text: [For] YHWH your God [is] among you, the Mighty One [who] saves; He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet [you] with His love; He will be joyous over you with singing.”

verses.text: “Those sorrowing from the appointed time I will gather [up], [put away] from you they will be—a lifting away, [and] along with it reproach.

verses.text: Behold, I will be dealing with all who afflict you at that time; and I will save the lame, and those driven out I will gather, and I will set them for praise and for renown in every land of their shame.
